hold.instructions: Add a Cloudflare API token to enterprise contractent as vendor cloudflare (kind api_key: an account-scoped token with Zone:Edit, DNS:Edit and Pages:Edit) on the enterprise's Credentials page. Rigger makes the zone for contractent.test once it lands; the token never goes in the business file or CI.

Create github.com/contractent and install the runsheet App on it. GitHub has no API that makes an organization, so this step is a person's: make the org at https://github.com/account/organizations/new, then install the App at https://github.com/apps/runsheet/installations/new and choose contractent. Rigger links it to the runsheet org contractent and applies its settings once both are done.
The slug contractent is an enterprise's, and no org can have it. Rename the business in .runsheet/businesses/contractent.yaml to a slug no enterprise or org holds.
